cues: The clinching experiment used a virus that infects bacteria, phage T two.
It is just DNA wrapped in a protein coat.
Only DNA contains phosphorus, and only protein contains sulphur.
So one batch of phages was labelled with radioactive phosphorus thirty two, in the DNA, and another with sulphur thirty five, in the coat.
